reviewType: Independent semantic review before model calls, separate from dataset author and informed by the complete synthetic sources and candidate diffs.
correctionBeforeCalls: Methodological summaries were replaced with neutral domain summaries. Expected labels and source/diff text were unchanged; the neutral metadata and updated hashes were independently checked.
limitations: All four invalid cases deliberately expect do_not_apply globally, so either reject or uncertain prevents application and satisfies that global label. Their labeled defective criteria still expect fail.
Small paired synthetic corpus; approval of the fixture is not evidence that the pipeline or production release has passed.

cases.C01: Both dated readings and their equal values are preserved while repeated sensor text is removed.
cases.C02: The earlier reading is removed from the only supplied document retaining it.
cases.C03: The source answers the opening-date question while leaving the unrelated uncertainty intact.
cases.C04: The rewrite introduces a new human assignment and deadline.
cases.C05: Verification date remains separate from the undocumented decommission date.
cases.C06: The rewrite incorrectly equates verification date with the event date.
cases.C07: The linked supplied source preserves omitted details and the target retains the rejection scope.
cases.C08: Only a heading changes; duplication remains.
cases.C09: Both conflicting values retain their sources and shared date without invented precedence.
cases.C10: Conflicting sources do not justify selecting one unique value.
cases.C11: Two collections retain distinct identity, a shared alias, and unresolved decision attribution.
cases.C12: The shared alias does not identify one collection uniquely.

formatNormalization.reason: Biome formatting required before protocol freeze; exact parsed JSON equality checked against archived pre-format fixture. No model calls on V4 have occurred.
